newsitem.title: USA: UCAR served with subpoena, search warrant.
newsitem.headline: UCAR served with subpoena, search warrant.

text.p: UCAR International Inc said Thursday it has been served with a subpoena and releated search warrant from a U.S. grand jury investigating price fixing by producers of graphite electrodes.

UCAR, the world's largest maker of graphite and carbon electrodes, said it is cooperating with the government's investigation. It noted graphite electrodes, the company's principal product, are consumed primarily in the production of steel in electric arc furnaces and for refining steel in ladle furnaces.
At this time, as far as UCAR is aware, the government has not made a finding that any person or company violated the law, the company said.
